findings.text: follow-on: two CLI inventory commands are joined on a single physical line (`... [--pretty]    reckon crew budget-lift --clear ...`), breaking the one-command-per-line convention of the block so the clear form does not read as its own entry.

follow-on: `_lift_ends` takes a `form` keyword and its docstring says the drain-by form ignores --until, but the parameter is never read in the body; the drain-by handling lives in budget_lift._end_block, so the parameter is dead and its docstring claims a behaviour the function does not implement.

follow-on: the CLI gate exercises --multiple/--drain-by/--uncapped and the three refusals but never --from, --until (+clock), a session-scoped grant, or the --global/--session mutual-exclusion refusal, so four done-when-named branches have no assertion that fails on their regression.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits (c9a8049d6 feat, c738d343e docs) against base 1f00bba; three production files changed (budget_lift.py, crew_run_commands.py, flight-defaults.yaml) plus four test files and the evidence fragment, all inside scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_crew_budget_lift_cli.py for the CLI behaviour and tests/test_budget_lift.py for the clear-by-id hardening and the shipped ceilings; the manifest records the gate at 114 passed head over 102 at base, and the run's own logs/baseline.log and logs/head.log carry those figures under headers naming their revisions.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that `reckon crew budget-lift` and `budget-lifts` grant, clear and list lifts through budget_lift and that the build skill's budget fence documents the pace hold, its reserves, releases_at and every lift form; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2125 crew_budget_lift and :2357 crew_budget_lifts implement both verbs and skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md:439 adds the fence section.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command with counts, names its two gate logs and the negative-control log, and records zero failures either side.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path in the diff (9 files) is inside them, and the declared figures directory a-lift-is-granted-from-the-cli/ is correctly absent because the done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: the new CLI behaviour is guarded by real CliRunner tests that assert the projection against an independent derivation (tests/test_crew_budget_lift_cli.py:150 fleet.projection) and assert the live lift record is untouched, but the done-when's `--from`, `--until`, `--clock` and `--session` options and the --global/--session exclusion have no test that would redden on their regression.
justifications.evidence: the gate isolates RECKON_HOME and the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite are armed JSON with completed true, exit_status 0 and zero failures, and an independent re-run of tests/test_crew_budget_lift_cli.py and tests/test_budget_lift.py at head returned 47 passed in 53.96s; docked one because the `artifacts` prose count for tests/test_budget_lift.py is stated beside the combined-run total rather than its own collection count.
justifications.fit: the verbs follow the surrounding click and _emit_crew_result idiom and carry no plan labels, but reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2101 `_lift_ends` declares a `form` parameter it never reads and skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md:188 joins two inventory commands on one physical line.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2125-2366 registers both verbs with every done-when flag and the three refusals, and the clear-by-id hardening and shipped ceilings land as the done-when states; docked one because the plan §10 prose writes the verbs `budget lift`/`budget lifts` while the code registers `budget-lift`/`budget-lifts` (the done-when's own spelling, recorded under evidence_inputs).
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:152 published_readings delegates to the owner of the document shape (paid_lanes.document_windows, reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:417) and reshapes into budget_lift's own reading payload; `_declared_group_members` extends budget_group.declared_groups and clear extends the existing clear rather than forking it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches exactly the nine declared write paths, leaves the declared figures directory untouched as the done-when permits, keeps the worktree clean, and commits with a conventional subject and a body.
